# Copper Line

> Training for data center HVAC and mechanical technicians: HVAC troubleshooting, mechanical maintenance, refrigerant safety and building envelope fundamentals.

Copper Line (https://dc-hvac.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs HVAC Troubleshooting, Mechanical Systems Maintenance, Cooling & Refrigerant Safety, Building Envelope Fundamentals training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://dc-hvac.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [HVAC Systems Troubleshooting Essentials](https://dc-hvac.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hvac-troubleshooting-essentials): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours. Hands-on troubleshooting skills for CRAC/CRAH systems and common cooling failures. Enroll: https://dc-hvac.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hvac-troubleshooting-essentials?buy=836
- [Mechanical Systems & Equipment Maintenance](https://dc-hvac.hazwoperosha.us/courses/mechanical-systems-maintenance): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours. Hands-on mechanical maintenance — piping, chillers, and vibration diagnostics. Enroll: https://dc-hvac.hazwoperosha.us/courses/mechanical-systems-maintenance?buy=838
- [Data Center Cooling System and Refrigerant Safety Training](https://dc-hvac.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-cooling-refrigerant-safety): $99.99 per seat, 2 Hours, EPA/OSHA. Refrigerant handling and cooling system safety practices specific to data center CRAC/CRAH environments. Enroll: https://dc-hvac.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-cooling-refrigerant-safety?buy=851
- [Building Envelope Fundamentals](https://dc-hvac.hazwoperosha.us/courses/building-envelope-fundamentals): $99.99 per seat, 2 Hours. Understand how a facility's building envelope drives cooling load and energy cost. Enroll: https://dc-hvac.hazwoperosha.us/courses/building-envelope-fundamentals?buy=1096

## Guides

- [CRAH vs CRAC: what's the difference?](https://dc-hvac.hazwoperosha.us/guides/crah-vs-crac): Two units that look alike on the floor and work very differently.
- [Five troubleshooting habits of good data center techs](https://dc-hvac.hazwoperosha.us/guides/troubleshooting-habits): How experienced mechanics find the fault without making it worse.
